summary: Frontend-only validation of 9 new IronFlow features (7-15) via web preview at localhost:3000 (mobile viewport 390x844). Seeded localStorage with sessions/PRs/habits/wellness/measurements before navigation. All 9 features verified PASSING: [7] xp-card present on '/' showing NIVEAU 2, 530 XP, hint '70 XP → niveau 3 · badge 🔥 Débutant motivé au N5', progress bar and tap routes to /profile. [8] Mobilité subtab shows 'create-mobility-program' button (green border) that navigates to /custom-program/new?category=stretch. [9] Training subtab order confirmed: Musculation → Mobilité → Séances → Historique (testIDs seg-program/seg-mobility/seg-individual/seg-sessions). [10] qa-meal card present in FAB QuickAdd modal with title 'Ajouter un repas' + subtitle 'Saisie rapide de calories'; routes to /meal/new which shows 'APPORT DU JOUR', target/current kcal + progress bar, all 6 presets (Petit-déjeuner 400, Déjeuner 700, Dîner 600, Collation 200, Fruit 80, Boisson sucrée 150) with testIDs preset-*, custom input+save-meal button, and reset-day. Tapping Fruit then Petit-déjeuner correctly increments to 480 kcal. [11] Exercises tab has 3 sub-tabs ex-cat-musculation/ex-cat-cardio_machine/ex-cat-mobility. Musculation: 13 rows rendered (including Squat avec barre, Développé Couché, Soulevé De Terre, Pompes, Tractions Strictes — displayed with capitalize text transform); each row shows 'Pas encore pratiqué' or '1 séance'. Cardio: SkiErg, Rameur, BikeErg present. Mobilité: Couch Stretch, World's Greatest Stretch, Wall Sit (Chaise) present. [12] Seeded habit kind='water' target=2000 with wellness water_ml=2000 → habit 'Boire de l'eau' auto-completed (checkbox filled, line-through) and score jumped to 38%. [13] Dashboard '/' has NO feeling-card testID and NO 'Comment te sens-tu' text; /daily-journal correctly shows all 4 dj-feeling-0..3 buttons. [14] Détail du score renders on Progression → Score with each row (Régularité/Sommeil/Nutrition/Eau/Pas journaliers/Habitudes) showing '% pill badge' AND brBar+brFill progress bar structure below (confirmed via code inspection at progression.tsx:305-328). [15a] /compare page renders 3 seeded photos in before/after (not empty state); after adding 4th measurement and re-focusing (nav to '/' then back), all 4 photos appear (useFocusEffect works). [15b] Gallery mode toggle: tap testID mode-gallery shows '3 photos — ordre chronologique' grid with testIDs gallery-m1/m2/m3, each showing '#1 01 janv. 26 75 kg' etc. in oldest-first order; tap mode-compare switches back correctly.

issues: Exercise names displayed with word-level capitalize text-transform (e.g. 'Développé Couché' instead of source 'Développé couché'). Cosmetic only, functional list is correct. No action required unless main agent wants French casing preserved.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/utils/stats.ts:36 still crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLowerCase)' if any seeded/legacy session.exercise lacks a `name` field. Not part of this iteration's scope (was flagged in iteration_10 as latent). Reproduced during seeding attempt when I used {exerciseName} instead of {name}. Suggestion: guard `const key = (ex.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();`.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx correctly removes FeelingCard (only XP + Streak hero + Wellness widgets remain).
/app/frontend/src/utils/xp.ts formula xpForLevel(N)=100*N*(N+1)/2 verified: 6 sessions×50 + 2 PRs×100 + 1 daysWithSession×5 = 300+200+30 = 530 XP → level 2 (needs 100→L1, 300→L2, 600→L3). Correct.
/app/frontend/src/utils/scoring.ts:107-141 correctly Math.max's the habit's manual value with the wellness-derived progress, so hitting the water widget auto-completes any water-kind habit for score.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded via page.evaluate BEFORE navigation. Keys used: @ironflow/sessions (6 sessions for XP), @ironflow/prs (2 PRs), @ironflow/habits (h_water kind='water' target 2000 + h_read kind='reading'), @ironflow/wellness ([{date: today, water_ml:2000, calories_kcal:400, steps:5000}]), @ironflow/profile ({water_target_ml:2000, calories_target_kcal:2000, steps_target:10000}), @ironflow/measurements (m1..m3 with photoBase64 60px orange square, then m4 added mid-test to validate useFocusEffect). Sessions use `name` (not `exerciseName`) and `sets` with string weight/reps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: use CURRENT date from `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` for wellness log key (getWellnessLog uses todayYYYYMMDD). Sessions must have exercises[].name (not exerciseName) and sets[].weight (string), sets[].reps (string), sets[].completed=true — otherwise computeAdvancedStats crashes at stats.ts:36. The '+' FAB opens a modal (not a route) — click testID='tab-add' to open. Compare page uses useFocusEffect so navigating away and back re-reads localStorage measurements. Exercise library rows are rendered with `textTransform: 'capitalize'` on each word — DO NOT rely on lowercase strings matching innerText; scrape for capitalized versions or count 'Pas encore pratiqué'/'N séance' markers.
